title: 第6章 这位大婶您这是嚎谁呢？
slug: 侯府商女全本免费-侯府商女最新章节列表
content_zh:
“是啊，是啊，表姑娘真的出事了吗？”
“是啊，昨个我不当值，难道表姑娘真的出事了吗？”
“今个一来就听说了，难道表姑娘真的出事了？”
“哎春丽你就在大夫人房里，你姐姐翠丽还是大夫人跟前的脸的大丫鬟，这事情你都不知道？”
春丽老实的道：“我姐姐昨个不当值，今个跟在大夫人跟前，我哪里敢去问啊，再说昨晚上值夜的是大夫人跟前凌嬷嬷，谁敢问凌嬷嬷啊？”
其他几个丫头感觉春丽说的也有道理，谁吃饱了撑的这时候还敢去惹大夫人啊？一个小丫头弱弱的问道：“你们说表小姐是真出事了吗？”
一群等级不同的奴婢，对于这个事情十分的好奇和八卦，你一言我一语的，很快这平时冷清的清花阁就如菜市场一般的热闹！
旁边一个嘴巴快的小蹄子立刻接过来道：“可不是，你们几个不知道，昨夜表姑娘哪里是出事了，是真的出事了，一盆盆的血水端出去都吓死人了，最后都找了太医院的杜太医呢，杜太医都说要是昨个救治不及时，表姑娘就够呛了，还说这两日不醒来，还是会有生命危险的！”
“就算醒来了，也要静养一段日子，说表姑娘跌入冰冻的荷花池，全身多处摔伤了，不知道是不是伤了骨头呢，这么大的事情，闹得昨晚上大老爷和大夫人一夜没睡，害的大少爷都跟着担惊受怕了一夜，真不明白这表姑娘没事大晚上的玩什么随风椅，这不是惹事吗，真是讨厌。”
这个快嘴的小蹄子，就是伯府长房最出色的大少爷卢俊辉身边的二等丫鬟春柳，平时嘴巴最快，又是个不让人的，说出话来又快又急，已经十四岁了，就等着要是能被大少爷收房就幸福完美了！
一旁的春嵋道：“哎呦，春柳你这是心疼大夫人，还是心疼大少爷啊，谁不知道你的心思啊，用得着这样直白吗？不就是表姑娘喜欢咱们大少爷吗，你不用这么醋妒吧？再说大少爷已经定了朱家的五姑娘，过半月就下小定，过两个月就成亲，这是满府皆知的事情，我看你应该担心的是朱家的五姑娘吧。”
这朱家五姑娘可不是个善茬，朱家女子善妒是京城人尽皆知的事情，这朱家五姑娘就是因为传出来的名声太过于善妒，所以亲事一直不怎么好说，反而让仁安伯府捡到了。
想到这里春柳的脸色青白交错，牙齿咬着嘴唇，不过又想起了大少爷的温柔多情对自己的承诺，春柳的脸色又害羞起来。
不少奴婢都看着春柳吃吃的笑着，好似谈论这情感问题，就像讨论白菜几个铜钱一斤似的平常，可见大宅门也不是处处都守规矩的。
甚至有些小丫鬟和感情不错的丫鬟还起哄起来，不知道的还以为这开什么联谊会，而不是在讨论表姑娘生命危在旦夕这样沉重的话题。
春柳被说中了心事，立刻就要过来抓春嵋，一边脸色绯红的嚷道：“去你的春嵋，在乱说看我不撕了你这个小蹄子的嘴，朱家的五姑娘岂是咱们的身份能编排的，咱们做奴婢的不过是希望主子好罢了，这个随风椅还是大少爷亲自给表姑娘定做的，出了这样的事情，大少爷昨夜一晚上都没睡，自责的不得了。”
春嵋自然清楚这里面的一些事情，说是随风椅好听，不过就是个能坐两个人带靠背的秋千罢了，她是真的没看出看来哪里就好了？偏生那表姑娘还当成宝贝一般。
春嵋是府里长房嫡次女卢代蓉的二等丫鬟，和春柳没有什么利益冲突，已经有了亲事，准备将来跟着姑娘做陪房呢。
春嵋自知戳中了春柳的痛处，所以扁扁嘴道：“好啦春柳咱们不闹了，都是做奴婢的，想多了没用，不过这表姑娘都折腾一夜了还没有醒吗？”
几个人都摇摇头，不知道都在想什么，虽然春柳不待见表姑娘叶沁慧，但是也不敢祈祷让她有事，否则她放在心头肉上面的大少爷难辞其咎！

而春丽真的没想到，不过是一夜没回来，就出了如此的大事，春丽眼波一转，想起表姑娘叶沁慧，哎，真是同人不同命！

content_en:
"Yes, yes, has something really happened to my cousin?"
"Yes, I was not on duty yesterday. Did something really happen to my cousin?"
"I heard about it when I came here today. Could it be that something really happened to my cousin?"
"Hey Chunli, you are in the eldest lady's room. Your sister Cuili is also the maid in front of the eldest lady. You don't even know about this?"
Chunli said honestly: "My sister was not on duty yesterday, but she is following the eldest lady today. How can I dare to ask? Besides, it was Grandma Ling who was on duty last night in front of the eldest lady. Who dares to ask Grandma Ling?"
Several other girls felt that what Chunli said made sense. Who dared to mess with the eldest lady at this time when they were full? A little girl asked weakly: "Do you think something really happened to my cousin?"
A group of slaves of different ranks were very curious and gossiped about this matter. They talked to each other, and soon the usually deserted Qinghua Pavilion became as lively as a vegetable market!
A quick-talking little boy next to him immediately took over and said, "No, you guys don't know what happened to my cousin last night. Something really happened. I was frightened to death when I brought out basins of blood. In the end, I went to Dr. Du from the Tai Hospital. Dr. Du even said that if the treatment yesterday was not timely, my cousin would be in trouble. He also said that if she doesn't wake up in the next two days, her life will still be in danger!"
"Even if you wake up, you have to rest for a while. My cousin fell into the frozen lotus pond and was injured in many places on her body. I don't know if she broke her bones. Such a big thing made the eldest gentleman and eldest lady stay up all night last night. The eldest young man was also worried and scared all night. I really don't understand how my cousin was playing with the wind chair at night when she was fine. Isn't this causing trouble? It's really annoying."
This quick-talking little hooves is Chunliu, the second-class maid next to Lu Junhui, the most outstanding young master in the eldest house of the uncle's house. She usually has the fastest mouth, and she is also a bit shy. She speaks quickly and urgently. She is already fourteen years old, and she is just waiting to be taken over by the young master. She will be happy and perfect!
Chun Mei on the side said: "Oh, Chunliu, do you feel sorry for the eldest lady or the eldest young master? Who doesn't know what you are thinking? Do you need to be so straightforward? Isn't it just that my cousin likes our eldest young master? Don't you? Are you so jealous? Besides, the eldest young master has already made an appointment with the fifth girl of the Zhu family. He will make a small decision in half a month and will get married in two months. This is something everyone knows. I think it is the fifth girl of the Zhu family that you should be worried about. "
The fifth girl of the Zhu family is not a good person. It is a well-known fact in the capital that the women of the Zhu family are jealous. Because of the reputation of the fifth girl of the Zhu family, they are too jealous, so the marriage has not been easy to talk about. Instead, the Ren'an residence found it.
Thinking of this, Chunliu's face turned blue and white, and he bit his lip with his teeth, but then he remembered the gentle and affectionate promise made to him by the eldest young master, and Chunliu's face became shy again.
Many slaves looked at Chunliu and giggled, as if discussing this emotional issue was as normal as discussing a few copper coins a pound of cabbage. It can be seen that the gate of the mansion is not always abiding by the rules.
Some of the little maids and the maids with whom they were in a good relationship even started to make noises. Those who didn't know it thought it was some kind of sorority party, rather than discussing such a serious topic as the cousin's life was in danger.
Chunliu was told what was on his mind, and he immediately came to arrest Chunmei. He shouted with a blushing face: "Fuck you Chunmei, you are talking nonsense. If I don't tear your little boy's mouth off, how can the identity of the fifth girl of the Zhu family be faked by us?" "No, we slaves just wish our master well. The young master personally ordered this chair for his cousin. If something like this happened, the young master didn't sleep all night, and he was so sorry for himself."
Chunmei naturally knew something about this. She said that the wind chair sounded nice, but it was just a swing that could seat two people with a backrest. She really didn't see where it looked.Already? Unfortunately, the cousin girl still treated her like a treasure.
Chunmei is the second-class maid of Lu Dairong, the second daughter of the eldest son of the house. She has no conflict of interest with Chunliu. She is already married and plans to follow the girl as a companion in the future.
Chunmei knew that she had hit Chunliu in a sore spot, so she flatly said, "Okay Chunliu, let's stop making trouble. We are all slaves. It's useless to think too much, but this cousin has been tossing all night, and she still hasn't woken up?"
Several people shook their heads, wondering what they were thinking. Although Chunliu didn't want to see her cousin Ye Qinhui, he didn't dare to pray that something would happen to her, otherwise the young master she cared about would be blamed!
And Chunli really didn't expect that such a big thing would happen after just not coming back for one night. Chunli's eyes turned and she thought of her cousin Ye Qinhui. Hey, we have the same person but different destiny!
